title: Separate quotient equality from representative evaluation
obstacle: An Lp/a.e. statement is being consumed as a pointwise fact.
procedure: Record whether each object is a quotient class, selected measurable function or continuous representative.
Use proved regularity and positive-measure neighborhood conditions only when a pointwise conclusion is required.
verification: Reject an unproved continuity condition or fixed-point value of an arbitrary Lp class.
positive_example: A continuous representative inherits an essential bound via positive measure of open neighborhoods.
negative_example: Changing a function at one point preserves its Lp class and may change its point value.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.
